item.name: SRCH-08 Verify server caps oversized page

exec: console.log('SEARCH LIMIT '+pm.response.text());pm.test('Oversized page is rejected or capped at documented maximum',()=>{if(pm.response.code===400)return;pm.response.to.have.status(200);const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.size).to.be.at.most(100);pm.expect(b.items.length).to.be.at.most(100)});
